i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC), flare_memory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.window_column, oa.overall_avg_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb), CombinedResults AS (SELECT pv.display_name AS entity_name, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, pv.benchmark AS benchmark_value, pv.variability_category AS category, 'Prime display-name cache-update variability' AS reason FROM prime_variability AS pv UNION ALL SELECT fm.instance_uuid AS entity_name, fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb AS metric_value, fm.overall_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_value, CASE WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb > 0 THEN 'ABOVE_OVERALL_AVG' WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb < 0 THEN 'BELOW_OVERALL_AVG' ELSE 'AT_OVERALL_AVG' END AS category, 'Flare3 instance memory deviation' AS reason FROM flare_memory AS fm) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, benchmark_value, category, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), avg_meta AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(metadata_value AS FLOAT)) AS avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (CAST(ic.metadata_value AS FLOAT) - am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta AS am), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i2.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.metadata_value, q1.NETWORK_INFO, q1.window_column, q1.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.has_active_migrations FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(ism.id) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC), sq2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sq1.display_name, sq1.memory_total_stddev, sq2.coefficient_of_variation FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.display_name = sq2.display_name ORDER BY sq1.memory_total_stddev DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_total_stddev, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, STDDEV(m.disk_total) AS disk_total_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN `migrations` AS m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_total_stddev, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_stddev DESC

WITH StateRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), StateCounts AS (SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(power_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM StateCounts GROUP BY vm_state, power_state WITH ROLLUP), MigrationCV AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(m2.id) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN `migrations` AS m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE m2.status = 'completed' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sr.vm_state, sr.power_state, sr.total_instances, mc.coefficient_of_variation, mc.completed_migration_count FROM StateRollup AS sr LEFT JOIN MigrationCV AS mc ON mc.vm_state = sr.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN sr.power_state = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, sr.vm_state, sr.power_state

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), Enriched AS (SELECT ic.display_name, ism2.value AS image_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m WHERE (m.source_compute = i.host OR m.dest_compute = i.host) AND m.deleted = 0 AND NOT m.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS host_migration_status, ic.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism2.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND ism2.deleted = 0 JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic2 ON iic2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND iic2.deleted = 0) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE image_type END AS image_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(host_migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(image_type) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE host_migration_status END AS host_migration_status, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM Enriched GROUP BY image_type, host_migration_status, display_name WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, MAX(inner_cte.max_memory_total) AS max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name) SELECT q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q1.row_count, q2.max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name

WITH Q1_inner_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0), AvgOfGroupMax AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_total * 1.0) AS avg_group_max_memory_total FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT avg_group_max_memory_total FROM AvgOfGroupMax)), Q2_inner_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2)) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.status, q1.max_memory_total, q1.created_at, q2.min_migration_id, q2.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM Q1_inner_cte AS q1 JOIN Q2_inner_cte AS q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME
